Bug_Explanation: The code uses a boxed primitive Integer as a lock object, which is dangerous because boxed primitives can be cached and shared inadvertently, leading to potential synchronization issues.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case creates two instances of BoxedPrimitiveLock and runs showBug method concurrently on both in separate threads. Since both instances use the same Integer value as the lock, they end up sharing the lock due to Integer caching. This leads to a potential synchronization issue, and the test case fails by design to demonstrate this problem.
